_comment: The desktop share every managed machine can have: the agent's own package carries RustDesk, so nothing is installed. Its switch, config/devices/<id>/remote_desktop.json, is off on a new machine; on, the agent runs its copy of RustDesk under RustDesk's own service names, and off, puts back what was there.
name: remote_desktop
title: Remote desktop
description: Shares this machine's desktop through the agent's own RustDesk
